name: Area Play
author: NexArea
description:
A fast, good-looking game launcher for PS Vita.
Your PS Vita, PSP and PS1 games, retro systems and homebrews in one place, with covers and backgrounds downloaded automatically.
Retro games launched directly with RetroArch, Emu4Vita++ or standalone emulators. Four views per menu, favourites, collections, instant search, 26 accent colours, wallpapers.
New in 1.1: in-app updates, Wi-Fi transfer from a PC or phone (QR code), quick menu (hold START), optional return to Area Play after a game, built-in HTTPS (no iTLS-Enso needed).
Touch screen and buttons. English and French.
Video (1.1): https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=P_4iEr5-eq4
Trailer: https://youtu.be/WNm3kU46JUY
requirements: HENkaku / Enso. Wi-Fi for covers and updates (no iTLS-Enso needed). Optional: RetroArch, Emu4Vita++, Adrenaline.
